Russia says it is counting on President Trump to continue his peace initiatives in Ukraine,
despite the change in power in Congress.
More on this from NPR's Charles Mains.
In an interview with state media, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Trump's efforts
to end the war in Ukraine had already produced some results.
Peskov pointed to upcoming U.S.-sponsored talks between Russia and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi
next week, as well as First Lady Melania Trump's recent humanitarian efforts in Ukraine as examples.
However, those initiatives followed a decision by Trump to purchase Russian diesel and table

Russia's senior Russian diplomat, Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Repkov, suggested the new

From Washington, this is NPR News.
Israel's President Isaac Herzog is accepting the certified results of last week's parliamentary
elections in that country.
Today he said he would begin consultations with party representatives to form a new government.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's religious national bloc lost its majority in parliament
while Arab-led parties made historic gains.
Netanyahu sought to discredit the results with unsubstantiated claims that Arab-led
parties stole the election.
Around the world, adolescents are not getting nearly enough exercise, according to new estimates
from the World Health Organization, and PR's Maria Godoy reports 1 in 14 said they failed
to get at least one hour of physical activity on any given day in the prior week.
Kids and teens should get at least 60 minutes each day of moderate to vigorous physical
activity like playground play, skateboarding, or soccer, according to public health guidelines.
The WHO says globally just 14 percent of adolescents meet these recommendations.
On average, adolescents reported being active for less than three days a week, a situation
that the WHO says hasn't improved in the last 15 years.
And in almost every country, the report found girls were less likely to be active than boys.
The findings were based on population-based surveys in 140 countries and territories.
They appear in the journal The Lancet Global Health.
Maria Godoy and PR News.
We're seeing a sharp rise in U.S. stocks, with the Dow Jones industrial average up more

This is NPR News.
